title: Learning Stratified Policies for Inference-Time Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2611.23154v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Inference-time scaling improves the performance of large language models by sampling multiple responses and evaluating their collective utility. However, many existing approaches obtain these samples by repeatedly sampling from a single policy. In this work, we study if the sample budget at inference time can instead be allocated across a population of policies. We introduce stratified policies, where each of $k$ learned policies contributes one response to a $k$-sample inference-time objective. We realize this policy population using separate LoRA adapters on a shared language model backbone and optimize it for pass@$k$. We theoretically motivate the approach by analyzing the linear setting; a population of LoRAs can achieve zero best-of-$k$ approximation error in settings where every single LoRA has strictly positive prediction error. Empirically, we demonstrate that stratified policies consistently improve pass@$k$ over a single-pol

translated_title: 面向推理时目标的分层策略学习
translated_abstract: 推理时扩展通过采样多个回复并评估其整体效用来提升大语言模型的性能。然而，许多现有方法都是从单一策略重复采样来获取这些样本。在本工作中，我们研究是否可以将推理时的采样预算分配到一组策略群体之中。我们提出了分层策略，其中 k 个学习到的策略各自为一个 k 样本的推理时目标贡献一个回复。我们通过在共享的语言模型主干上使用独立的 LoRA 适配器来实现这一策略群体，并针对 pass@k 进行优化。我们从理论上通过分析线性设定为该方法提供了依据：在每一个单独的 LoRA 都具有严格正预测误差的设定下，LoRA 群体可以实现零的 best-of-k 逼近误差。在实验上，我们证明了分层策略在 pass@k 指标上始终优于单一策略基线。
tldr: 该论文提出“分层策略”，通过在共享语言模型主干上训练 k 个 LoRA 适配器，将推理时的采样预算分配给一个策略群体，并从理论和实验上证明这种策略群体在优化 pass@k 时优于单一策略。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces stratified policies—a population of k LoRA adapters on a shared LLM backbone that distributes the inference-time sample budget across multiple policies—and shows theoretically and empirically that this improves pass@k over a single policy.
